title: Disruptive raises $10B fund to make big bets on at least 10 companies
slides: Can a $10B fund buy disruption itself?
Disruptive CEO says the model is shifting fast
It commits capital before targets even exist
Large deals may now crowd out smaller founders
Ask your investors: who sets the urgency?
thread_text:
1. $10B to Buy Disruption

A fund just committed capital before targets even exist. That's not investing — that's buying the urgency itself.

2. CEO: Model Is Shifting

The disruptive CEO says the game changed: capital now moves before strategy. Founders are left guessing who sets the pace.

3. Deals Before Targets

Money gets wired before there's a plan. That flips the usual order — and small founders feel the squeeze first.

4. Big Deals, Small Doors

Large checks crowd out smaller founders who can't compete for attention. The pipeline narrows before it even opens.

5. Ask Your Investors

Who sets the urgency in your round? If you can't answer, you're not in control. Ask them this week.
